notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
We have addressed the bug where enemies carrying treasures unexpectedly appeared among reinforcements.
Currently, the reinforcements' items have been removed, allowing you to enjoy the game as intended.

Furthermore, the following fixes and updates are planned for the next update:

[olist]
[*] Correcting Kodiak's dialogue in the Zoa Kingdom.
[*] Changing the color of the circles at the feet to easily identify allies who have already taken their turn.
[/olist]

That concludes the update.
Thank you for your continued support for "After He Was Gone".

Nono

notes.title: Bug Fix: Achievement Unlock Issue
notes.notes:
We discovered a bug where achievements could not be unlocked during second or subsequent playthroughs. This issue has now been fixed.

After updating the game, loading your save data will automatically unlock any achievements that were not properly unlocked.
For those who have not yet updated manually, please update your game.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy [i]After He Was Gone[/i].

— Nono
